import os

import requests

API_URL = "https://api.mailprovider.example/v3/messages"


def send(to_addr, subject, body):
    resp = requests.post(
        API_URL,
        headers={"Authorization": f"Bearer {os.environ['MAIL_API_KEY']}"},
        json={"to": to_addr, "subject": subject, "html": body},
        timeout=10,
    )
    resp.raise_for_status()
    return resp.json()["id"]

"""Integration test: sends one real email through the provider sandbox.

Needs MAIL_API_KEY (sandbox key from the dev secrets store) and MAIL_SINK_URL
(the sink inbox API endpoint). Skipped when either is missing.

The sandbox accepts (202) but silently drops mail to any recipient outside
@sink.acme.test, so we send there and read the message back from the sink.
It is capped at 2 msg/s and 500/day for the whole team: keep this to one send.
"""
import os
import time
import uuid

import pytest
import requests

from notifier import email

SINK_URL = os.environ.get("MAIL_SINK_URL")
RECIPIENT = "receipts@sink.acme.test"

pytestmark = pytest.mark.skipif(
    not (os.environ.get("MAIL_API_KEY") and SINK_URL),
    reason="MAIL_API_KEY and MAIL_SINK_URL are required for sandbox tests",
)


def _find_message(message_id, timeout=30, interval=2):
    deadline = time.monotonic() + timeout
    while time.monotonic() < deadline:
        resp = requests.get(
            SINK_URL,
            params={"to": RECIPIENT},
            headers={"Authorization": f"Bearer {os.environ['MAIL_API_KEY']}"},
            timeout=10,
        )
        resp.raise_for_status()
        for msg in resp.json().get("messages", []):
            if msg.get("id") == message_id:
                return msg
        time.sleep(interval)
    return None


def test_send_receipt_is_delivered_to_sink():
    invoice_id = f"inv_it_{uuid.uuid4().hex[:8]}"

    message_id = email.send_receipt(invoice_id, RECIPIENT, 1200)

    assert message_id
    msg = _find_message(message_id)
    assert msg is not None, "receipt was not delivered to the sink inbox"
    assert msg["subject"] == "Your receipt"
    assert invoice_id in msg["html"]
